visual_review: Native inspected against Standard/Relic originals in reference pair: same pistol geometry, three rear cuts, two grip pins, dark muzzle and side opening, original trigger/guard and panel seams. Pearl-ivory metal/ivory grip with faint muted blue trace at original inset only, pale warm-gold fittings. Relic scroll panel retained at same site with fine pale scroll seams; original single lower-pin repair retained as cool pale silver contrasting with warmer upper pin. Faint ivory-gold light confined to prior inlay and one original seam, no outside halo or muzzle emission. One complete object, no panel labels. Uniform registration/contour drift measured honestly; no artistic/exact-outline approval.
